findings.detail: D06 reports only 14 of 87 issuers persisted, but the raw 2023 and 2022 SOI pages contain many directly matching issuer names across periods, so the continuity extraction or issuer-normalization layer is undercounting persistence.

rationale: D06 is an aggregate continuity flag. The filing's raw SOI schedule is readable: 2023 investment tables 28-32 total investments at fair value of 876,197,259, and comparative 2022 tables 37-41 total investments at fair value of 815,424,661. The raw rows show numerous issuer continuations between the periods, including 48Forty Solutions, Accurate Background, Allentown, Speedstar, Dye & Durham, and SP-CREH 19 Highline in the cited row pairs. That source pattern is inconsistent with the flagged 16.1% continuity result, so the low continuity metric is a real extraction/normalization error rather than a true portfolio turnover signal.
